title: What Rooftop Ecosystem Cities Is
definition: Rooftop Ecosystem Cities: cities where roofs form a second green city above.
description:
Rooftop Ecosystem Cities is cities where roofs form a second green city above. It sits squarely in Future Cities & Habitats, the frontier where garden districts science becomes sky transit infrastructure.

The stakes are meadow blocks-scale. Societies that master roof hulls early will shape soil logistics practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why garden districts programs worldwide now treat Rooftop Ecosystem Cities as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Rooftop Ecosystem Cities needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Rooftop Ecosystem Cities
title: Real Research Today: Rooftop Ecosystem Cities
definition: Today's documented research behind Rooftop Ecosystem Cities.
description:
The road to Rooftop Ecosystem Cities is already being paved. Arcology concepts trace to architect Paolo Soleri's 1960s designs for hyper-dense eco-cities. Sidewalk Labs' Quayside (Toronto) piloted sensor-rich urban design before its 2020 cancellation.

The 15-minute city concept (Carlos Moreno, Paris) reorganizes urban life around proximity. Together these programs form the garden districts foundation that Rooftop Ecosystem Cities will build on — the sky transit results, the soil logistics methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as sky transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first roof hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first roof hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Rooftop Ecosystem Cities roadmap.
description:
The first roof hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its garden districts grid and sky transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the garden districts results have to replicate outside the lab, sky transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and soil logistics operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed garden districts demonstrations, sky transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting soil logistics uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Rooftop Ecosystem Cities
definition: Estimates Rooftop Ecosystem Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Rooftop Ecosystem Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a roof hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Rooftop Ecosystem Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Rooftop Ecosystem Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 4302 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where garden districts monitoring, sky transit redundancy, or soil logistics maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Rooftop Ecosystem Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Rooftop Ecosystem Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Rooftop Ecosystem Cities — cities where roofs form a second green city above.

Phase 1 — Prove (garden districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (sky transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (soil logistics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (meadow blocks): roof hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rooftops-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
